subject: botany_2
question_text: What is meant by capping and tailing?

verification.note: Sourced from "Sr. Botany — My Baby Bullet-Q" (Sri Publishers, STAR-Q Pass Track), book p.44, printed question 98. Botany-II holds only ONE source book: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no Telangana Botany-II board paper is in the corpus, so the two-book union check and the board back-test are BOTH structurally impossible for this card — "not checked" does NOT mean "checked and clean". Run both the moment a second source or a real paper arrives. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. BOOK NOTE: the guide defines tailing as adding adenylate residues "in a template". NCERT says "in a template INDEPENDENT manner", which is the point: no DNA is read to make the tail. The card restores the word.

insider_note: Which end each happens at is the mark: cap at the 5' end, tail at the 3'.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Capping
steps.margin_note: The molecule, the end, and what the cap is for.
lines: CAPPING is the addition of an unusual nucleotide,
The cap protects the RNA and helps the ribosome
steps.why: The cap marks the front of the message, so the ribosome knows which end to start from.
common_mistakes: Putting the cap at the 3' end. It goes on the 5' end.
Naming the wrong molecule. It is methyl guanosine triphosphate.
steps.memory_tip: A cap goes on the head: the 5' end.

steps.label: Tailing
steps.margin_note: The residues, the count, the end, and what template independent means.

lines.text: Cap at the 5' end, tail at the 3' end

lines: TAILING is the addition of 200 to 300 ADENYLATE
residues to the 3' END, in a TEMPLATE
Template independent means no DNA is read to make
it — the adenines are simply added on.
steps.why: No DNA codes for the tail, so it cannot be found in the gene — which is exactly what template independent means.
common_mistakes: Leaving out 'independent'. The guide drops it, and 'in a template' means the opposite.
Putting the tail at the 5' end. It goes on the 3' end.
steps.memory_tip: Tail at the tail end, and nothing is copied to make it.
